# Book guards

Generated by the guard test (`go test -run TestGuards -update`); do not edit.

A command is applied only if no guard on its action refuses it; a refused one changes nothing and offers the remedies.

## Guards

| guard | checks | why | keeps | remedies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| calendar-title-readable | sessions.create, sessions.update, followUps.create, followUps.update | An event's title is read before anything changes | policy: the calendar changes only what its title clearly says | calendar.revert, calendar.ignore |
| name-is-a-client | sessions.create, sessions.update, followUps.create, followUps.update | Every session and follow-up is a client's: a title names one of them | policy: a session or follow-up belongs to a client | clients.save, calendar.revert, calendar.ignore |
| name-can-be-written | sessions.create, sessions.update, followUps.create, followUps.update | An event's title must read back as its client | policy: the calendar shows every session and follow-up in its syntax | clients.save |
| fee-known | sessions.create, sessions.update | Something pays for every session: a fee, a credit, or the client's usual fee | credit-with-invoice | clients.save, packages.save, calendar.revert, calendar.ignore |
| document-lifecycle | documents.saveDraft, documents.issue, documents.revise, documents.discardDraft, documents.cancel, documents.moveLines, packages.makeStandalone | A document takes its steps in order: drafted, issued, revised or cancelled | policy: a document's lifecycle (see documents) | none: it isn't at that step |
| sessions-never-overlap | sessions.create, sessions.update | She sees one client at a time: no two sessions overlap, whoever's they are | sessions-never-overlap | calendar.revert, calendar.ignore, sessions.update |
| calendar-delete-keeps-the-record | sessions.delete | Deleting an event in the calendar never deletes what she recorded on its session | policy: a calendar delete never loses her notes | calendar.revert, sessions.delete |
| delete-keeps-money | sessions.create, sessions.update, sessions.delete, packages.save, packages.delete, packages.makeStandalone, documents.saveDraft, documents.issue, documents.revise, documents.discardDraft, documents.cancel, documents.moveLines, payments.set, clients.save | What was received for something is never deleted with it | policy: money received is only undone on purpose | payments.set, packages.makeStandalone |
| issued-documents-never-change | sessions.create, sessions.update, sessions.delete, packages.save, packages.delete, packages.makeStandalone, documents.saveDraft, documents.issue, documents.revise, documents.discardDraft, documents.cancel, documents.moveLines, payments.set, clients.save | What an issued invoice or receipt says is final: a change goes through a new document | issued-documents-never-change | documents.cancel; not built yet: documents.creditNote, documents.debitNote |
| sold-packages-keep-their-size | packages.save, sessions.update | How many sessions a package has is what was sold: once invoiced, it changes through a new invoice | issued-documents-never-change | documents.cancel; not built yet: documents.creditNote, documents.debitNote |
| revision-only-corrects | documents.saveDraft | A revision corrects what is printed, never what an issued document charges, to whom, or when | issued-documents-never-change | documents.cancel; not built yet: documents.creditNote, documents.debitNote |
| invoice-once-confirmed | documents.issue, sessions.update | An invoice is issued for confirmed sessions only | tentative-with-issued-invoice | sessions.update, documents.cancel |
| settle-once-confirmed | payments.set | A payment is recorded for a confirmed session | policy: a tentative session may not happen | sessions.update |
| pay-what-is-owed | payments.set, packages.save | Only what is owed is paid: a credit or a fee of nothing leaves nothing to pay | paid-nothing-due | none: nothing is owed |
| undo-before-free | sessions.create, sessions.update, sessions.delete, packages.save, packages.delete, packages.makeStandalone, documents.saveDraft, documents.issue, documents.revise, documents.discardDraft, documents.cancel, documents.moveLines, payments.set, clients.save | Something made free owes nothing, so what was received for it is undone first | paid-nothing-due | payments.set |
| paid-in-full | sessions.create, sessions.update, sessions.delete, packages.save, packages.delete, packages.makeStandalone, documents.saveDraft, documents.issue, documents.revise, documents.discardDraft, documents.cancel, documents.moveLines, payments.set, clients.save | What was received for something is what it costs: a change to one changes the other | paid-in-full | payments.set |
| fees-stay-invoiced | documents.saveDraft, documents.moveLines, documents.discardDraft | Every fee and package is on an invoice, which says what it costs | credit-with-invoice, invoiced | none: move its line to another draft, or delete what it charges |
| credits-in-hand | sessions.create, sessions.update, sessions.delete, packages.save, packages.delete | A credit covers a session from a package of its client that still has it | overdrawn, credits-of-own-package | packages.makeStandalone, sessions.update |
| bought-package-follows-its-session | packages.save | A package bought in a session is that client's, bought that day | bought-in-its-session | sessions.update, packages.makeStandalone |
